name: SEL
signature: (rows | table, family pattern, predicates over fields, bound row) -> rows
definition: Keep the rows of a family whose fields satisfy each predicate, where a predicate compares a field with a constant, a table cell, a field of a bound row (which makes it a join on a referenced id) or membership in another expression's result.
parameters: family pattern with leaves; state mark (admitted, landed); predicates = < <= in subset on fields, first_held and asserted_at included; as-of instant t (first_held <= t)
incremental: yes: hash index per (family, field) for equality and reference predicates, O(1) per added row; ordered index for instant comparisons, O(log n)
status: existing: guard grammar selector `family@state[field=field] as E` (tools/guard_grammar.py, 43 clauses in transitions.json); fold `reads=` (tools/fold_grammar.py, 46 parts)

name: TOP
signature: (rows, key fields, order list) -> one row per key
definition: Group rows by a key and keep the one that ranks first under a lexicographic order list (rank of verb, max asserted_at, min id).
parameters: key fields; order list of rank(...) | max(field) | min(field); absent default; as-of instant
incremental: yes for "now": one head per key, compare-and-replace O(1). As of a past instant: per-key history ordered by asserted_at, O(log n). Removing a row (purge) re-folds that one key
status: existing: fold `key=` and `pick=` with the default `rank(recants>withdraws>supersedes),max(asserted_at),min(attestation_id)` (81 parts); change grammar `link=ranked:`; formal/event_lifecycle

name: SPAN
signature: (opening rows, open instant, closers, instant t) -> rows open at t
definition: Give each row an interval from a named instant to the earliest of its closers (an expiry member, the open instant plus a named duration, the instant of a closing row that references it) and keep the rows whose interval holds t.
parameters: open = asserted_at | first_held | a member; closers = member | +duration name | closing SEL; t = now | first_held | another row's instant; which clock (signed or receipt)
incremental: yes with a timer queue: an added closer is O(1); an interval closing by the clock alone needs a priority queue keyed by close instant, O(log n) per row and one pop per expiry
status: existing: reactions.json expiry (20) and clock (19) entries with `from`, `dur`, `by`; fold `cut=`; guard `at`, `within`, `after`; governance window_secs; formal/two_path

name: CNT
signature: (rows, group fields, voice mapping, aggregate, threshold form) -> value or bool per group
definition: Group rows, reduce each group by one aggregate from a closed list (count distinct voices; sum, min, max, median of a field), and optionally compare with a threshold of the one rational form max(min_count, ceil or floor+1 of num*base/den).
parameters: group fields; voice = key | person (key mapped through OWNER); aggregate in {count_distinct, sum, min, max, median, all}; threshold = integer | fraction (num, den, base, min_count, strict or not) | base law (k, tail, min)
incremental: count, sum: yes O(1) with a set per group. min, max: O(1) on add, re-fold of the group on removal. median: O(log n) with an order-statistic structure. The threshold moves when the base set moves, so every open count over that set is re-tested
status: existing: fold `over=`, `combine=`, `test=` (46 parts); governance_policy.json counted columns and decider; formal/two_path, formal/census_ballot (base law and ratchet)

name: CHAIN
signature: (seed, step expression, bound) -> the end or the path
definition: Start from a seed and apply a step expression (itself O1-O4) repeatedly, each step reading the previous result, until no step applies, a bound is reached or a named target is met.
parameters: seed rows or keys; step; depth bound; stop target; cycle rule
incremental: partly: a head pointer advances in O(1) when links arrive in order. A link arriving late in the middle, or a retraction of a middle link, re-folds the suffix: O(length of suffix). Reachability with deletions has no O(log n) answer in general; the depth bound is what keeps it small
status: partly: fold `pick=chain(prev_head_digest)` (4 cells), signer rule `via delegates_to(scope, depth, ...)`, formal/trust_set (walk with depth), formal/accord_roster, formal/owner_binding each have their own chain; no table states one chain form with seed, step and bound

name: GLUE
definition: Combine results: and, or, not, union, minus, is-empty (one / no / all), and first-arm-that-holds over a list of cases.
incremental: yes, O(1) given its inputs, but a NOT or a NO over a growing set makes the result non-monotone: a new row can turn yes into no, so every result that reads it must be re-tested
status: existing: guard quantifiers `one|no|all|each|set` with `&` and `else`; count cell arms joined by ` ; `, first that holds; the governance decider
